question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, from the time the Soviet Union dissolved onward, list the occasions on which someone proposed him as a candidate for an elected office or he was officially nominated for one, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần được đề xuất hoặc đề cử ra ứng cử (thị trưởng Moscow 1992, gợi ý tổng thống 1996, đề cử tổng thống 2007) nên phải liệt kê đủ.
criterion: someone else proposed him as a candidate for an elected office, or he was officially nominated for one (endorsements and his own announcements do not count)

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, summarize the steps of his bid for the Russian presidency, from his announcement of plans to the hearing of his appeal before the cassation board.
why_needs_multiple: Bảy bước của cùng một đợt tranh cử tổng thống từ thông báo đến phúc thẩm, cần tổng hợp đủ bảy mốc.
criterion: any step of his 2007-2008 bid for the Russian presidency: announcement of plans, endorsement, official nomination, filing, electoral commission decision, or appeal

question: How many calendar years passed from his election as president of the Florence-based Comitatus pro Libertatibus to his announcement of plans to run for the Russian presidency?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc role đã nêu tên (chức chủ tịch tổ chức và thông báo tranh cử), hỏi khoảng cách năm.

question: Among the dated steps of his bid for the Russian presidency, what came right after his official nomination?
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là mốc kế tiếp sau mốc đề cử chính thức trong chuỗi đầy đủ các bước tranh cử.
criterion: any step of his 2007-2008 bid for the Russian presidency: announcement of plans, endorsement, official nomination, filing, electoral commission decision, or appeal
